Finally, subjects were young males with an average body weight of approximately 82 kg (181 lb); the total protein intake of 80 g therefore was far below their daily requirement to maximize anabolism (approximately 130 to 180 g). In sum, each of these factors, alone or in combination, may have unduly influenced findings and thus limit extrapolation to real-world scenarios (126).
